structure: 减省关系从句 + which 指代 + 不定式做定语
intro_zh: 橡树资本（Oaktree）联合创始人 Howard Marks 2015 年在 Google 做的演讲，讲他那本《The Most Important Thing》的来历。这是演讲的收尾：他留给听众三句他最看重的投资格言，接着回答第一个观众提问——如果人人都在躲输家，是不是反而该去追赢家？

sents.en: So lastly, I'll just leave you with what I consider my three greatest adages.
sents.zh: 最后，我把我心目中最了不起的三句格言留给大家。

sents.en: Not mine but the ones I've encountered over my career and that have been the most helpful.
sents.zh: 不是我说的，是我这些年碰到的、对我帮助最大的三句。

hl.text: the ones I've encountered over my career
hl.note: 省略关系代词的定语从句：the ones (that) I've encountered。先说 the ones，再补「我碰到的」。

sents.en: And they're all used in the book.
sents.zh: 书里都用到了。

sents.en: First of all, what the wise man does in the beginning, the fool does in the end.
sents.zh: 第一句：智者起初做的事，愚者最后才做。

sents.en: In every trend in investing, it eventually becomes overdone.
sents.zh: 投资里的每一个趋势，最终都会走过头。

sents.en: If you find an asset which is cheap and buy it, that's great.
sents.zh: 你发现一项资产便宜，买下来，这很好。

sents.en: If everybody else figures it out that it's cheap, then it will go up.
sents.zh: 等别人都看明白它便宜了，它就会涨。

sents.en: Then people see that it's rising.
sents.zh: 然后人们看到它在涨。

sents.en: And more people jump on the band wagon and it goes up, up, up.
sents.zh: 更多人跟风上车，它就一路涨、涨、涨。

sents.en: And the last person to buy it is a fool.
sents.zh: 最后一个买进的人是傻子。

hl.text: the last person to buy it
hl.note: the last person to do：不定式做定语，「最后一个买的人」。

sents.en: And the first person to buy it is a wise man.
sents.zh: 第一个买进的人是智者。

hl.text: the first person to buy it
hl.note: the first person to do：同一个结构，和上一句对照着练。

sents.en: It's the same asset.
sents.zh: 资产是同一个。

sents.en: Just at different prices.
sents.zh: 只是价格不一样。

sents.en: And as people say, first the innovator, then the imitator, then the idiot.
sents.zh: 就像大家说的：先是创新者，然后是模仿者，最后是傻瓜。

sents.en: So that's another way to look at this adage.
sents.zh: 这是理解这句格言的另一个角度。

hl.text: another way to look at this adage
hl.note: another way to look at…：way + to do，「看待…的另一个角度」。

sents.en: Number two, never forget the six foot tall man who drowned crossing the stream that was five feet deep on average.
sents.zh: 第二句：永远别忘了那个身高六英尺的人，他过河时淹死了，而那条河平均水深只有五英尺。

sents.en: Kind of like that skydiver who's right 98% of the time.
sents.zh: 有点像那个 98% 的时候都没出错的跳伞者。

sents.en: It's not sufficient, depending on how you want to live your life, to survive on average.
sents.zh: 「平均来说能活下来」是不够的——当然这取决于你想怎么过日子。

sents.en: We have to survive on the bad days.
sents.zh: 我们得在糟糕的日子里也活下来。

sents.en: So we have to be able to survive the low spots in the stream.
sents.zh: 所以我们得扛得过河里最深的那几段。

sents.en: Your portfolio has to be set up to survive on the bad days so you won't be shaken out of your investments.
sents.zh: 你的组合必须搭得能扛过坏日子，这样你才不会被震下车。

sents.en: And then finally, being too far ahead of your time is indistinguishable from being wrong.
sents.zh: 最后一句：领先时代太多，和犯错没有区别。

sents.en: And yet, that's a great challenge because, as I said before, the things that are supposed to happen will not necessarily happen.
sents.zh: 而这是个很大的挑战，因为我前面说过，该发生的事不一定会发生。

sents.en: And they absolutely will not happen on time.
sents.zh: 更绝对不会按时发生。

sents.en: So you have to be able to live until the wisdom of your decisions is proved, if at all.
sents.zh: 所以你得能撑到你的决定被证明是明智的那一天——如果真有那一天的话。

sents.en: So all of these things, I think, say something about modesty and humility of belief rather than cock sureness, which I think is the greatest risk.
sents.zh: 所以我觉得，这几句话讲的都是信念上要谦逊、要虚心，而不是过分笃定——在我看来，过分笃定才是最大的风险。

hl.text: , which I think is the greatest risk
hl.note: which 指前面的 cock sureness（过分笃定），中间还插了 I think：「而我认为这才是最大的风险」。

sents.en: So with that, [INAUDIBLE], I'll stop talking.
sents.zh: 那么，我就讲到这儿。

sents.en: And we have a little time left.
sents.zh: 我们还有一点时间。

sents.en: And I'd love to take your questions.
sents.zh: 很乐意回答大家的问题。

sents.en: That's what I'm here for.
sents.zh: 我就是为这个来的。

sents.en: Thank you, Howard.
sents.zh: 谢谢你，Howard。

sents.en: This was fascinating.
sents.zh: 讲得太精彩了。

sents.en: So we are open for questions.
sents.zh: 现在开始提问。

sents.en: Please raise your hand, and I'll bring the mic to you.
sents.zh: 请举手，我把话筒递过去。

sents.en: The thing you said about what the wise man does in the beginning the fool does in the end, you can come up from a single stock.
sents.zh: 你说的「智者起初做的事，愚者最后才做」，可以从单只股票往上推。

sents.en: You can think about your whole philosophy that way.
sents.zh: 你的整套理念也可以这么看。

sents.en: So you've been focusing here on avoiding losers.
sents.zh: 你今天一直在强调避开输家。

sents.en: And maybe humans are, kind of, generally focused on trying to find winners.
sents.zh: 而人大概普遍都是盯着找赢家。

sents.en: Maybe that's what we'll always do wrong.
sents.zh: 也许这正是我们永远会做错的地方。

sents.en: But if everybody in the world is trying to avoid losers, maybe the wise investor now shoots for the winners, do you know what I mean?
sents.zh: 但如果全世界都在努力避开输家，那聪明的投资者现在也许该去追赢家了，你懂我意思吧？

sents.en: Sort of self-balancing.
sents.zh: 算是一种自我平衡。

sents.en: Sure.
sents.zh: 当然。

sents.en: Well, number one, I don't think that we have to worry about everybody becoming to prudent or to wise because we're talking about human nature.
sents.zh: 嗯，第一，我不认为需要担心所有人都变得太谨慎、太明智，因为我们谈的是人性。

sents.en: Charlie Munger-- the boys went to see Charlie Munger this week.
sents.zh: Charlie Munger——这几位小伙子这周刚去见了 Charlie Munger。

sents.en: One of the great quotes that Charlie gave me was from the philosopher Demosthenes, who said for that which a man wishes that he will believe.
sents.zh: Charlie 送给我的金句里有一句出自哲学家 Demosthenes，他说：人愿意相信什么，就会相信什么。

sents.en: What do most people want more anything else?
sents.zh: 多数人最想要的是什么？

sents.en: They want to get rich.
sents.zh: 是发财。

sents.en: Very few people think that the secret to their happiness comes from prudence and caution.
sents.zh: 很少有人认为幸福的秘诀在于审慎和小心。

sents.en: Most people think it comes from that stroke of genius, which will put them on easy street.
sents.zh: 多数人觉得靠的是那一下神来之笔，从此就能过上舒服日子。

hl.text: , which will put them on easy street
hl.note: which 指前面的 that stroke of genius：先说完名词，再补它会带来什么。

sents.en: But you're absolutely right.
sents.zh: 不过你说得完全对。

sents.en: And there are times when most people behave in a prudent and cautious manner.
sents.zh: 确实有些时候，多数人都表现得审慎又小心。

sents.en: When is it?
sents.zh: 是什么时候？

sents.en: It's in a crash when security prices are down here.
sents.zh: 是崩盘的时候，证券价格跌到这儿。

sents.en: Right?
sents.zh: 对吧？

sents.en: That's the time to turn aggressive and buy.
sents.zh: 那才是该转守为攻、出手买入的时候。

hl.text: the time to turn aggressive and buy
hl.note: the time to do：不定式做定语，「该…的时候」。

sents.en: So Buffett says the less prudence with which others conduct their affairs the greater the prudence with which we must conduct our own affairs.
sents.zh: 所以 Buffett 说：别人行事越不审慎，我们自己行事就越要审慎。

sents.en: And there are times when we should turn aggressive.
sents.zh: 也有些时候我们该转为进攻。

sents.en: And that's when everything's being given away.
sents.zh: 那就是所有东西都在白送的时候。

shadow.tips: 断句：And the LAST person to buy it / is a FOOL. buy it 连读 bu-yit；is a 连读 i-za；last 和 fool 对比重读。
断句：So that's aNOther way / to LOOK at this adage. look at 连读 loo-kat；that's another 连成一串。
断句：And then FInally, / being TOO far ahead of your time / is indisTINguishable / from being WRONG. ahead of 连读 ahea-dov；is 前面停一下，这是主语结束的地方。
断句：MOST people think / it comes from that STROKE of genius, / which will put them on EAsy street. which 前面停顿并降调；stroke of 连读 stro-kov；put them 读成 put'em。
断句：THAT'S the time / to turn agGRESsive / and BUY. turn aggressive 连读 tur-naggressive；and 弱读成 ən。

questions: Explain the first adage in your own words. Who is the wise man and who is the fool? (Try: "The first person to… / the last person to…")
What is the point of the six-foot-tall man story for a portfolio?
Why is being too far ahead of your time a problem to worry about?
What does Marks think is the greatest risk? (Try: "He warns against…, which he thinks is…")
When does Marks say is the time to turn aggressive?
Think of a trade where you were right but too early. What was the hardest thing to do while waiting? (Try: "The hardest thing to do was…, which…")
